info.title: Nexartis NANDA Node API
info.description: REST API for the Nexartis NANDA Node — agent registration, certification, health probes, payments, and developer key management.

get.description: Public endpoint returning trust badges computed from reputation data. Filterable by agent ID.
Returns agent count, registration trends, and capability distribution.
Full-text search with optional capability, tag, trust, jurisdiction, and protocol filters. Supports SafeSearch mode.

post.description: Resolves an agent to its best endpoint using multi-strategy scoring (latency, trust, protocol, geo).

get.description: Returns signed AgentAddr record with endpoint URL, trust score, and Ed25519 signature.
Returns reputation snapshots merged with certification grades for all agents.

post.description: Upsert an agent registration. Auto-creates a Lean Index AgentAddr for DNS-like resolution.

auto_discover.description: When true, auto-discover protocols at agent_url

get.description:
Returns the operator's approval policy wrapped in an Ed25519 signature
(NND-D2). Consumed by Remote-Control clients (G8) at connect. Clients
verify the signature against `/.well-known/keys/ed25519-v{n}` and
apply the policy per §7 of the RC client ARCHITECTURE. TTL 60 s.

post.description:
JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol endpoint. Supports tools/list and tools/call.
Available tools: nanda_lookup_agent, nanda_search_agents, nanda_list_agents,
nanda_get_reputation, nanda_check_cert, nanda_check_health, nanda_register_agent,
nanda_get_agentfacts, nanda_resolve_agent, nanda_federation_status, nanda_create_workflow,
nanda_run_workflow, nanda_trust_scores, nanda_compliance_check, nanda_subscribe_webhook.

get.description: Returns full registration details for a specific agent.
Returns all agents in the registry with parsed capabilities and tags.

Checks D1 database, R2 storage, and KV cache. Returns 503 if any check fails. Pass `?probe=secrets` to additionally probe each declared secrets_store_secrets binding via `.get()` and report per-binding status (machine-readable, consumable by the tenant deploy-worker.yml post-provision assertions).

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: When set to `secrets`, deep-probes each Secrets Store binding.

get.description: Returns federation status including v1 pull-sync and v2 CRDT gossip state.
Returns all known federation peer registries with status and last sync time.

post.description: Register a new peer. Requires federation admin key.
Registers the caller as a peer and reciprocally registers this node on the caller.
CRDT gossip inbound endpoint. Merges agent state from peer registries using LWW-Element-Set CRDTs.

get.description: Returns all agents imported from peer registries via federation sync.

200.description: Array of federated agents with source peer

get.description: Returns StatusList2021 credential for VC revocation checking. Cached for 5 minutes.

201.description: Subscription created (includes secret — show only once)

post.description: Record a visitor from vault-gate. Upserts by email.
Create a new UCP checkout session for agent-to-agent payments.

get.description: Retrieve a checkout session by ID.

patch.description: Submit payment information for a checkout session.

get.summary: Query cross-registry trust scores (API key required)

get.description: List registered trust frameworks (ToIP-aligned). Filter by framework ID.
Query trust graph edges. Get edges for a DID or compute trust path between two DIDs.

parameters.name: did
parameters.description: DID to get trust edges for

post.summary: Sync cross-registry trust scores (apikey or admin)

get.description: Returns the active subscription for a given API key.

post.description: Create a new subscription with plan, billing cycle, and currency.

get.description: Returns subscription details with event history.

patch.description: Change plan or update subscription settings.

get.description: List workflows filtered by owner ID or status.

post.description: Create a new multi-agent workflow with DAG-ordered steps.

get.description: Returns workflow run with step results and status.
Server-Sent Events stream of workflow run progress. For real-time monitoring.

post.description: Non-streaming retrieval of run event history.
Cancel a pending or running workflow run.
Uses multi-strategy scoring to find the best agent for an action (trust, latency, capability match).

get.description: Returns available workflow patterns (fan-out, pipeline, consensus, etc).

post.description: Create a custom orchestrator pattern.

get.description: List delegation tasks for a workflow.

post.description: Delegate a task to a sub-agent via A2A routing.

get.description: List conflict events for a workflow run.

post.description: Raise a conflict for resolution when agents produce conflicting results.

get.description: Returns conflict details and resolution status.

patch.description: Submit a manual resolution for a conflict.

get.description: Returns workflow with steps and DAG definition.

patch.description: Update workflow name, description, status, or DAG.

delete.description: Permanently delete a workflow and its steps.

get.description: Returns all runs for a workflow.

post.description: Start a new execution of a workflow.

get.description: Returns invoices for a given API key owned by the caller.

post.description: Generate a new invoice for a billing period.

get.description: Returns invoice details by ID. Caller must own the invoice's key, or be an admin.

403.description: Not the owner of the invoice

patch.description: Issue or void an invoice. Caller must own the invoice's key, or be an admin.

403.description: Not the owner of the invoice

post.description: Creates a new developer API key. Requires session authentication (not API key auth).

403.description: API key auth not permitted or non-admin tier request

get.description: Lists all developer API keys for the authenticated user. Requires session authentication.

delete.description: Revokes a developer API key. Requires session auth and ownership of the key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The API key ID to revoke

404.description: Key not found or not owned by user

get.description: Returns earnings summary for the authenticated developer. Admins may pass `developerId` to inspect another user.

parameters.name: developerId
parameters.description: Admin-only override to look up another developer.

post.description: Settle pending earnings or register a new revenue split.
Scheduled gossip push to all healthy federation peers. Internal cron endpoint.
Syncs agents from all enabled external registries. Internal cron endpoint.

get.description: Agent behavior analytics including probe success rates, latency trends, and anomaly detection.

200.description: Behavior metrics with trends and anomalies

get.description: Federation v2 status including peers, gossip stats, and ZTAA policy.

post.description: Register/remove peers or evaluate ZTAA policy.

get.description: Billing summary or period listing for an API key.
Aggregated payment analytics for the admin dashboard. Supports daily, weekly, monthly ranges.
Returns full registration for a specific agent.

put.description: Partial update of agent_url, api_url, facts_url, capabilities, tags.

delete.description: Remove agent from registry. Requires federation admin auth.

put.description: Update an agent's operational status and optionally its capabilities.

post.description: Re-crawls the agent's /.well-known/agent-card.json and updates registration and facts.

get.description: Returns AgentFacts JSON for an agent. Use ?format=vc for a Verifiable Credential envelope.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Return VC-wrapped facts if set to "vc"

200.description: AgentFacts data (plain JSON or VC envelope)

put.description: Store AgentFacts metadata for an agent.
